parole.significato: harem (private part of an Arab house, esp. the women's quarters)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish حرم, from Arabic حَرَم (ḥaram).
Ultimately from Ottoman Turkish عثمان (osman), from Arabic عُثْمَان (ʕuṯmān, personal name).

parole.significato: vilayet (province or administrative division of the Ottoman empire)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Ottoman Turkish ولایت (vilâyet), from Arabic وِلَايَة (wilāya, “province”). Perhaps mediated via another European language.
